scores.justification: The 3-color DFS with a path index correctly detects back edges and reconstructs the cycle; self-loops yield ['A','A'], target-only nodes are collected into all_nodes and handled via graph.get(u, []), and the outer loop covers disconnected components. Path/path_idx bookkeeping is correctly unwound on backtrack, so no stale entries can produce a bogus cycle. Only minor quibbles: recursion could blow the stack on very deep graphs, and the returned cycle repeats the start node (explicitly documented with a slice suggestion), which is a defensible convention.
